commit 902d633e56e1ecdb967880623716d0f691068794
Author:     Evandro Baginski <ebaginski@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Jun 5 10:16:18 2026 -0700
Commit:     Evandro Baginski <ebaginski@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Fri Jun 5 10:16:18 2026 -0700

    Bug 2045127 - Add flatpak lint to flatpak repack script r=sking
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D304988

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
index c81b12e9927..9248c9acc2e 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ WORKDIR /scripts/
 
 # Copy everything in the docker/tb-flatpak folder but the Dockerfile
 # Use globs to avoid accidentally copying the injected run-task/ directory.
-COPY *.sh *.c *.ini *.in *.svg /scripts/
+COPY *.sh *.c *.ini *.in *.svg *.json /scripts/
 
 # Copy required recipes
 # %include comm/taskcluster/docker/recipes
@@ -27,5 +27,8 @@ RUN /scripts/make_venv.sh /scripts/fluent_requirements.txt
 RUN ["gcc", "-Wall", "-shared", "-o", "/scripts/close_range.so", "/scripts/close_range.c"]
 ENV LD_PRELOAD /scripts/close_range.so
 
+# Install flatpak-builder-lint
+RUN pip3 install git+https://github.com/flathub-infra/flatpak-builder-lint.git
+
 # Set a default command useful for debugging
 CMD ["/bin/bash", "--login"]
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/exceptions.json b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/exceptions.json
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..d059c4cb97a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/exceptions.json
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+{
+  "org.mozilla.thunderbird": [
+    "finish-args-gnupg-filesystem-access"
+  ],
+  "org.mozilla.thunderbird_esr": [
+    "finish-args-gnupg-filesystem-access",
+    "finish-args-own-name-wildcard-org.mozilla.thunderbird"
+  ]
+}
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index e7c5a90aba6..6a0b5cd74e9 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -214,6 +214,11 @@ flatpak build-export --disable-sandbox --no-update-summary --metadata=metadata.l
 ostree commit --repo=repo --canonical-permissions --branch=screenshots/x86_64 ${appdir}/share/app-info/media
 flatpak build-update-repo --generate-static-deltas repo
 
+# Lint the Flatpak repo against Flathub requirements
+# Capture exit code to avoid set -e aborting on failure
+flatpak-builder-lint --exceptions --user-exceptions "${SCRIPT_DIR}/exceptions.json" repo repo || LINT_EXIT_CODE=$?
+LINT_EXIT_CODE=${LINT_EXIT_CODE:-0}
+
 # Package Flatpak repo as tar
 tar cvfJ flatpak.tar.xz repo
 mv -- flatpak.tar.xz "$TARGET_TAR_XZ_FULL_PATH"
@@ -223,3 +228,5 @@ flatpak build-bundle "$WORKSPACE"/repo "${APP_ID}.flatpak" "${APP_ID}" "$FLATPAK
 
 # Move bundle to artifacts
 mv "${APP_ID}.flatpak" "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/"
+
+exit "$LINT_EXIT_CODE"
title: Bug 2045127 - Add flatpak lint to flatpak repack script r=sking
